sourceLicences.scopeNote: These are separate data-source terms, not one blanket licence or legal clearance for every scene asset or downstream use.

treeAssets.scope: Conceptual trees; not covered by the City of Mesa, OpenStreetMap or Landsat data-source licences.

heatComparisonStory.limits: Same historical overpass and equal-sized samples. Not air temperatures, whole-neighborhood averages, causal attribution or predicted tree cooling.

routeDistances.method: Horizontal straight-line distance between native 17 x 17 heat-sample centers in the scene local-metre coordinate frame; not route distance.

shadeIndicator.label: conceptual-shade-benefit
shadeIndicator.interpretation: Qualitative design-stage indicator only. Green denotes added conceptual tree shade, not a temperature measurement or quantified cooling.

shadeRendering.label: tree-shade-receiver
shadeRendering.purpose: Shadow-only receiver above the unchanged historical heat colors, so proposed tree shade remains legible.
shadeRendering.limits: Illustrative golden-hour lighting, not a dated solar study, measured shade percentage or thermal model.

reportingPrecision.interpretation: Reported means and comparison summaries are rounded to the nearest 0.1 C. Reporting increment is not instrumental accuracy or a confidence interval.
reportingPrecision.sourceValues: Source cell arrays are retained unchanged for reproducibility; their stored decimal places do not assert measurement accuracy.
reportingPrecision.independence: 30 m product-grid cells have approximately 100 m native thermal resolution; 289 grid cells are not 289 independent thermal measurements.
reportingPrecision.uncertainty: Per-pixel ST_QA uncertainty has not been evaluated for these windows; no numerical uncertainty or causal tree-cooling estimate is claimed.
reportingPrecision.differences: Temperature differences are computed before rounding and then reported to 0.1 C; visible captions use approximate whole-degree differences.

gisLayer.palette: Green -> yellow -> red; piecewise-linear sRGB, fixed 40-60 C; translucent to retain site context

gisLayer.limits: One overpass. Not air temperature, a time series, or a prediction of cooling.

reportingPrecision.differences: Temperature differences are computed before rounding and then reported to 0.1 C; visible captions use approximate whole-degree differences.

heat.source: USGS/NASA Landsat 9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature
heat.quality: ST_B10 DN != 0; QA_PIXEL bits 0–5 clear; all 289 cell centers inside Alta Mesa boundary.
heat.interpretation: Historical land surface temperature, not air temperature; not a whole-neighborhood average or a prediction of proposed tree cooling.
heat.colorScale: Green -> yellow -> red; piecewise-linear sRGB, fixed 40-60 C; translucent to retain site context

comparison.calculation: Difference computed before rounding; reporting precision is not instrumental accuracy.

reportingPrecision.interpretation: Reported means and comparison summaries are rounded to the nearest 0.1 C. Reporting increment is not instrumental accuracy or a confidence interval.
reportingPrecision.sourceValues: Source cell arrays are retained unchanged for reproducibility; their stored decimal places do not assert measurement accuracy.
reportingPrecision.independence: 30 m product-grid cells have approximately 100 m native thermal resolution; 289 grid cells are not 289 independent thermal measurements.
reportingPrecision.uncertainty: Per-pixel ST_QA uncertainty has not been evaluated for these windows; no numerical uncertainty or causal tree-cooling estimate is claimed.
reportingPrecision.differences: Temperature differences are computed before rounding and then reported to 0.1 C; visible captions use approximate whole-degree differences.
